name: victoria-metrics
title: VictoriaMetrics
description: VictoriaMetrics stores time series like Prometheus does, in less memory and disk, and answers the same queries (PromQL). After deploying, either add it to Prometheus as a remote_write target (http://VictoriaMetrics:8428/api/v1/write) or send data straight to it (InfluxDB, Graphite and OpenTelemetry formats are accepted), then add it to Grafana as a Prometheus data source with the URL http://VictoriaMetrics:8428.

variables.name: PORT_VICTORIA_METRICS
variables.label: Web port
variables.description: Host port of the web page (vmui) and the API

variables.name: VICTORIA_RETENTION
variables.label: Retention
variables.description: How long data is kept: a number is months (12), or use a unit such as 30d, 8w, 2y
